title: Athelstone of the Oval Resource Pack
description: This is the resource pack for athelstone of the oval which gives it the custom textures
body:
This resource retexures 12 blocks to add 9 Athelstone Clay blocks, Blood Manure a fertilizer  that used to be used at cricket grounds and a curated pitch and a bare wicket and a wicket for you to craft. Athelstone can be crafted using dirt, water and a shovel or found near beaches.
Download the datapack here [https://modrinth.com/datapack/athelstone-of-the-oval](https://modrinth.com/datapack/athelstone-of-the-oval)
